title: Forbidde Grounds Rescue
next_chapter_hook: "A hoarse voice echoed from the depths of the Forbidden Grounds, as if some ancient existence had awakened."

text.content:
On the mountain path behind the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters, Chen Ji's slender figure was faintly visible in the morning mist. His steps appeared casual, yet each one precisely avoided the line of sight of patrolling disciples. Last night's decision hung over his heart like a blade—the chess game in the imperial capital was important, but the news of Su Qingyao trapped in the Forbidden Grounds made it impossible for him to sit still.

"Heavenly Fate at forty-three points..." he calculated silently, "Activating the Fifth Page requires at least fifteen points. This journey will likely be perilous." Yet whenever Su Qingyao's icy cold face surfaced in his mind, the corners of Chen Ji's lips would involuntarily rise slightly. That woman claimed she wanted to investigate his background, but she never retreated when it mattered.

"Very well," he murmured to himself, "Someone must make the first move in this game." With that, Chen Ji drew a yellowed fragment from his chest—a replica of the Tianji Record's Fifth Page. The true Fifth Page had long merged with his soul. The runes on the fragment glowed faintly, as if sensing their master's resolve.

dialogue.content: "Are you certain about this?" A hoarse voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind. It was the unique tremor of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, "The Fifth Page's power is extraordinary. Once activated, your Heavenly Fate will drain rapidly. Moreover, the Heavenly Eye's gaze has never left this region."

text.content:
Chen Ji did not slow his steps, but his divine sense replied within his heart: "Perhaps Master forgets, I was always a废物. If I cannot even protect those beside me, what use is a Heavenly Fate stacked to one hundred?" His tone was calm, as if discussing something trivial.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent for a moment before sighing: "You child, you resemble your father in his youth even more."

"Resemble my father?" Chen Ji's steps faltered slightly, a complex glint flickering in his eyes before quickly returning to his usual composure, "Master speaks words I cannot comprehend again. When this matter is settled, you must tell me the story of Chen Xuan."

Passing through the final bamboo grove, the entrance to the Ancient Forbidden Land appeared before him. It was a bottomless fissure, with azure light seeping from its depths, accompanied by faint dragon roars. Chen Ji could feel an ancient and desolate aura rushing toward him—those were law fluctuations far beyond today's cultivation world.

"Tianji Pavilion ruins..." he murmured. The Tianji Record documented that in ancient times, there existed a Tianji Pavilion containing the secrets of heaven's workings, which later sank into the depths of the Forbidden Land due to some great catastrophe. He never expected it to be true.

Just then, Chen Ji's brow center throbbed—a warning from the Tianji Record. He looked up sharply to see a black shadow watching him from a distant mountaintop.

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji discovered someone covertly monitoring him. Should he immediately activate the Tianji Record's Fifth Page to lock onto Su Qingyao's position?"

choices.description: "Time is running short. Every moment Su Qingyao remains trapped brings greater danger. Her position must be locked immediately."
choices.risk_hint: "Heavenly Fate will drop to a dangerous range, and the Heavenly Eye will lock onto him"
choices.process_label: 天机录第五页缓缓开启，陈机的瞳孔中倒映出无数命运丝线

text.content:
The Tianji Record's Fifth Page erupted open. Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his brow center as the scene before him instantly became transparent. Countless points of light appeared in his vision—those were threads of fate. Among them, one dim golden light flickered within a collapsed palace in the depths of the Forbidden Grounds.

"Found her!" His heart tightened. That was the Tianji Pavilion ruins. However, just as this thought formed, a chilling killing intent rushed down from the mountaintop. Chen Ji cursed inwardly, hastily withdrawing his divine sense, but it was already too late—the black shadow dove down like an eagle capturing prey, targeting his brow center directly.

choices.description: "First eliminate or evade the observer to ensure不被追踪, reduce exposure risk."
choices.risk_hint: "Su Qingyao's situation may deteriorate, and the enemy's strength remains unknown"
choices.process_label: 陈机收敛全身气息，如同一片落叶般融入阴影之中

text.content:
Chen Ji's form flickered as he seemed to merge with the morning mist, silently moving toward the fissure. However, that black shadow was clearly no ordinary practitioner, blocking his path the instant he reached the entrance.

"Chen Xuan's son, you truly came." The shadow's voice was sinister, carrying undisguised mockery, "The former Sect Master was right. As long as we watched that woman, you would inevitably walk into the trap yourself."

Chen Ji's pupils constricted—Former Sect Master? Had Ling Yuan's reach extended this far?

The black shadow drew near, and Chen Ji finally saw the visitor's face—a middle-aged man in black robes, surrounded by eerie black mist, his cultivation having reached the pinnacle of Golden Core.

"A dog of the Heavenly Alliance?" Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, his tone carrying a hint of playfulness, "It seems the Heavenly Eye truly hasn't forgotten me."

The black-robed man冷笑一声: "Chen Xuan's cursed offspring, do you think hiding in this remote corner can deceive heaven's gaze? That Tianji Record was a seed heaven scattered among mortals. You are merely one fruit about to be harvested."

dialogue.content: "Fruit?" Chen Ji sneered, "Your Heavenly Alliance speaks so eloquently. Simply put, you want to use me as a chess piece, then discard me when spent?" He paused, cold intent flickering in his eyes, "Unfortunately, I Chen Ji despise being used as a chess piece most in this life."

text.content:
The black-robed man's expression darkened slightly, clearly enraged by Chen Ji's attitude: "Sharp-tongued wretch! Today I shall teach you how laughable your petty cleverness is before absolute strength!"

Before the words finished, he formed a seal with his hand, and a pillar of black light surged toward Chen Ji. It was the Heavenly Alliance's unique Annihilating God Finger, targeting cultivators' souls. An ordinary Golden Core cultivator struck by this would face annihilation of both body and soul.

Yet Chen Ji remained motionless, as if he had anticipated this attack long ago. His right hand formed seals secretly within his sleeve as his mind rapidly calculated the battlefield—Golden Core pinnacle, a direct confrontation offered no chance of victory. But what if he utilized the residual ancient laws of this place?

Just as the Annihilating God Finger was about to touch Chen Ji, a brilliant water mirror materialized before him. Its surface was smooth as a mirror, yet it reflected a scene utterly different from reality—a paradise of clustered flowers, immortal cranes circling, and gentle flowing streams.

"This is..." The black-robed man's pupils contracted sharply, his body involuntarily faltering.

Chen Ji's lips curved slightly: "Aren't you confident in seeing through everything? Then please, come in and observe the scenery within this mirror world."

choice.prompt: "Water Mirror Technique successfully trapped the enemy. Chen Ji faces a critical decision: seize the opportunity to escape, or thoroughly eliminate the hidden threat?"

choices.text: "Seize the Moment to Swiftly Enter the Forbidden Grounds"
choices.description: Su Qingyao's safety comes first. Killing this minion is a waste of time. Better to end this quickly.
choices.risk_hint: The enemy will alert more pursuers once they break free
choices.process_label: 陈机转身便走，身影化作一道流光冲向禁地入口

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't hesitate for a moment. His figure flashed as he rushed into the fissure of the forbidden grounds. Behind him, the black-robed man's furious roar echoed: 'Trying to escape? You think this pathetic illusion can hold me for long!'

A cold smile crossed Chen Ji's heart. Though the Water Mirror Technique's illusion couldn't trap a Golden Core peak cultivator for long, it could buy him at least half an incense stick's time. Half an incense stick was enough for him to find Su Qingyao.

The moment he passed through the fissure, an ancient, desolate aura rushed toward him. Chen Ji felt his vision blur as the surroundings transformed dramatically—broken walls and ruins flickered with ghostly blue light, and the air was thick with a terrifying fluctuation of laws, as if countless eyes were watching him from the void.

choices.description: Since we've already made our move, we cannot let news leak out. The Water Mirror Technique combined with the ancient laws of the forbidden grounds is enough to utterly annihilate this person.
choices.risk_hint: The commotion might alert other existences within the forbidden grounds
choices.process_label: 陈机双手结印，水镜术的幻境开始疯狂吞噬周围的上古法则之力

text.content:
Chen Ji's eyes turned cold. His hands formed seals at lightning speed. The ghostly blue light around him seemed to sense something, beginning to madly converge toward the water mirror. That was the law power accumulated over ten thousand years in the forbidden grounds, now flooding into the illusion.

'No... what is this!' The black-robed man惊恐地发现, his spiritual energy was being frantically devoured by that water mirror. The illusory peach blossoms and flowing water transformed into countless blades, slashing toward him from all directions.

The scream cut off abruptly. When the illusion dissipated, only a pool of black blood and a few scraps of torn clothing remained. Chen Ji glanced at it expressionlessly, then turned to step deeper into the forbidden grounds.

The scenery in the depths of the forbidden grounds was even more desolate than Chen Ji had imagined. Massive stone pillars lay broken on the ground, exquisite reliefs eroded beyond recognition by time. Only the ghostly blue crystals embedded in the walls still glowed faintly, illuminating this forgotten ruin.

'Tianji Pavilion...' Chen Ji slowed his pace, his gaze sweeping across every broken wall. The residual law fluctuations in the air made him uneasy—an intricate structure far beyond the current cultivation world's comprehension. Even with the Tianji Record's deductive ability, he could only understand two or three parts in ten.

Suddenly, a faint spiritual fluctuation came from ahead—it was Su Qingyao's aura! Chen Ji brightened, quickening his pace toward that direction. Passing through three collapsed corridors, a palace half-buried in rubble appeared before him. Above the palace entrance, four ancient seal characters could barely be made out: 'Pillar of Heavenly Fate'.

Chen Ji rushed into the palace without hesitation. Inside, it was dim and gloomy, with only a cluster of golden light hovering in the center being most conspicuous. And beneath that golden light, a familiar white figure sat cross-legged, eyes tightly closed, surrounded by a light blue spiritual barrier.

'Su Qingyao!' Chen Ji blurted out, rushing forward.

The woman's eyelashes trembled slightly as she slowly opened her eyes. Seeing it was Chen Ji, her usually icy face revealed an complex expression: 'How did you... come here?'

'If I didn't come, would you want me to watch you die here?' Chen Ji said impatiently, though his hands were already凝聚ing a ball of gentle spiritual energy, injecting it into her body to unblock her meridians, 'You're the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, the future pillar of Tianqing Sect. Without you, who's going to look after this servant disciple?'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao was momentarily speechless by his words, then snorted coldly: 'Glib tongue.' But her gaze softened a bit, 'I've been trapped here for three days. There's something strange about this palace—my spiritual energy is mostly sealed. I can't break free at all.' She paused, her eyes falling on Chen Ji, 'As for you, a servant disciple, how did you pass through the forbidden grounds?'

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart tightened, though his expression remained unchanged: 'Just luck. Speaking of which, the spiritual fluctuation on your body seems to have changed?' He changed the subject, carefully studying Su Qingyao.

Su Qingyao's brow furrowed slightly: 'I find it strange too. Ever since I was trapped here, a power I've never felt before seems to have awakened in my body... Look.'

She extended her right hand, and a faint golden mark appeared on her palm. That mark散发柔和的光芒, forming a sharp contrast with the ghostly blue light surrounding the palace.

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—that was the bloodline mark of the Celestial Realm's remnant clan! The Tianji Record documented that during ancient times, beings from the Celestial Realm descended to the mortal world. Their descendants scattered across various lands, their bloodline power passed down through generations, yet few could awaken it. And the mark in Su Qingyao's body was of extremely high rank!

'So that's it...' Chen Ji murmured softly, his mind racing to connect all the clues. Tianji Pavilion ruins, Celestial Realm remnant bloodline, Su Qingyao trapped here—none of this was coincidence.

'What did you say?' Su Qingyao frowned and asked.

'Nothing.' Chen Ji shook his head, 'Let's leave here first. That ball of golden light seems to be absorbing your bloodline power. Staying here any longer might be dangerous.'

He reached out to help Su Qingyao up, but the moment their fingers touched, a strange force suddenly erupted from that ball of golden light!

The golden light surged, and the entire palace shook violently. The ghostly blue crystals on the walls all lit up, carving complex formation patterns in the air. Chen Ji only felt the Tianji Record in his embrace suddenly become scalding hot, and the符文 on those fragments resonated with the formation patterns in the palace!

'This is impossible...' He stared wide-eyed at the bizarre phenomenon.

From within the golden light, a illusory figure slowly emerged. It was an白发苍苍的老者, surrounded by spiritual energy entirely different from today's cultivation world—that was the immortal yuan power of the Celestial Realm!

'How many years has it been... Finally, someone carrying the Tianji Record has arrived at this place.' The old man's voice was ancient and distant, 'Chen Xuan's son, do you know the true origin of this Tianji Record?'

dialogue.content: The old man's illusory gaze swept over Chen Ji and Su Qingyao, a meaningful smile appearing at the corner of his mouth: 'The Tianji Record is not an artifact that mortals could create. It is one of the shards scattered across the mortal realm when the Celestial Realm fell—fragmentary pieces of the Heavenly Dao's will. Each volume of the Tianji Record carries a thread of the Celestial Realm's will, and your scroll... is the core fragment personally refined by the Master of the Tianji Pavilion.'

text.content:
Chen Ji felt his mind explode like a bomb. The true origin of the Tianji Record, his father's legacy, all of this... was actually related to the fall of the Celestial Realm?

'Why did the Celestial Realm fall?' He suppressed the shock in his heart and asked in a deep voice.

The old man sighed: 'The Celestial Realm fell because of the Heavenly Dao's Eye's ambition. It was unwilling to remain a tool maintaining the operation of heaven and earth, coveting to devour all law power and become an existence surpassing the Heavenly Dao. In that battle, the Celestial Realm shattered, countless immortals perished, and the Heavenly Dao's Eye... was sealed in the deepest part of the river of time.'

He looked at Chen Ji, his gaze carrying a hint of pity: 'Unfortunately, the seal will eventually loosen. The Heavenly Dao's Eye is trying to awaken again, and the Tianji Record in your hand... is one of the key pieces in its scheme spanning ten thousand years.'

choice.prompt: The old man revealed shocking secrets, and Chen Ji faced a choice: continue to pursue the truth, or first lead Su Qingyao out of danger?

choices.description: Since we've come this far, we must understand what kind of chess game we're caught in. What is the Heavenly Dao's Eye's true purpose? Why did my father die?
choices.risk_hint: The disturbance in the forbidden grounds may attract more enemies
choices.process_label: 陈机按住想要离开的苏青瑶，目光灼灼地盯着老者虚影

text.content:
"Why did the Heavenly Eye choose me?" Chen Ji stared straight into the old man's eyes. "Since the Tianji Record is merely a chess piece, what does it want this piece to do?"

The old man fell silent for a moment before speaking slowly: "Every generation of Tianji Record holder is guided by it to collect other fragments. And when you gather all the fragments and truly complete the Tianji Record... you will become the vessel for the Heavenly Eye to reshape the world. Your soul will be devoured by it, your fate will become the nourishment for its resurrection."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly, yet he showed no excessive surprise. He had long suspected that the completion of the Tianji Record would come with an enormous price.

"And my father?" he pressed.

The old man sighed: "Chen Xuan was the most promising person in ten thousand years to break this fate. He had already gathered all seven volumes of the Tianji Record, but discovered the truth at the final moment. Thus he chose to split and hide the Tianji Record, sacrificing himself with a secret technique to draw the Heavenly Eye's attention to himself. Unfortunately..."

He glanced at Chen Ji: "Unfortunately, bloodlines cannot be severed. Your existence itself is the last contingency he left behind."

Chen Ji was silent for a long while, then suddenly let out a light laugh: "Fine indeed, Chen Xuan. Fine indeed, sacrificing oneself for justice. In the end, this son still has to clean up his mess."

Su Qingyao listened nearby, her heart trembling with fear. She never expected that this servant disciple who only swept floors in daily life would carry such a heavy destiny. What shocked her even more was that after hearing all this, Chen Ji still had that faint smile on his face.

"Chen Ji..." She started to speak but hesitated.

Chen Ji turned to look at her, a rare gentleness flickering in his eyes: "Don't worry, I'm mentally prepared. Since the Tianji Record chose me to walk this path, I'll walk it to the end—but in my own way."

choices.description: The truth is important, but the person before me matters more. Once we leave here, there will be plenty of opportunities to slowly interrogate.
choices.risk_hint: May have missed key intelligence, and the palace's strange movements have already exposed our location
choices.process_label: 陈机将苏青瑶护在身后，准备强行带她冲出宫殿

text.content:
"Elder, let's converse later." Chen Ji clasped his hands in a formal salute,不给 the old man any time to react. He wrapped an arm around Su Qingyao's waist and charged outward.

Su Qingyao's face flushed red from his sudden action: "What are you doing! Let go of me!"

"Stay still. Don't move." Chen Ji murmured, his footsteps never faltering. The Tianji Record in his arms remained scalding hot, its runes flickering erratically, as if resonating with some force within the palace.

However, just as the two were about to burst out of the palace, an ancient yet authoritative voice rang out from the depths of the void: "Think you can leave?"

The voice seemed to come from the highest heavens, carrying irresistible pressure. Chen Ji felt his entire body stiffen, an icy chill spreading from his spine throughout his limbs—this was the Heavenly Eye's projection of consciousness!

dialogue.content:
In the void, a massive vertical pupil slowly opened. That vertical pupil was jet-black as ink, yet within its depths burned ethereal blue flames, coldly gazing upon everything in the palace.

"Another generation of Tianji Record inheritor..." the voice thundered through the palace. "Chen Xuan's sacrifice merely delayed things for a moment. Now, you too shall become kindling for this seat's rebirth."

text.content:
Chen Ji felt an invisible pressure shrouding his entire body, as if he would be crushed to dust the next moment. Yet at this instant, the Tianji Record in his arms erupted with brilliant golden light, colliding violently with the vertical pupil's pressure!

Intense spiritual energy fluctuations spread in all directions, the entire palace shaking violently. The formation runes on the walls flashed madly, seemingly resisting something.

"Hmm?" A hint of surprise flickered in the vertical pupil. "The Tianji Pavilion Master's seal... still hasn't dissipated?"

Chen Ji seized the opportunity to stabilize himself, firmly guarding Su Qingyao behind him. He stared fixedly at that vertical pupil, yet a cold smile curved his lips: "So the Heavenly Eye is也不过如此, can't even break the seal of a ruined palace."

dialogue.content: The flames within the vertical pupil violently flared, an even more terrifying pressure pouring down: "Insolent creature... Do you think this seal can protect you for long? Once this seat fully awakens, even the ends of the earth won't allow anyone to escape!"

text.content:
Just as Chen Ji was about to retort, the white-haired old man's phantom materialized once more, standing before him.

"Heavenly Eye, you have slept long enough." The old man's voice was calm yet resolute. "The Tianji Pavilion Master sacrificed himself to become a formation, sealing you here. Today, let this old man end this."

The old man formed seals with both hands, and the formation runes throughout the palace all lit up simultaneously. Ethereal blue light converged into a massive chain, abruptly coiling toward that vertical pupil!

"Overestimating yourself!" the vertical pupil roared, pitch-black light colliding violently with the ethereal blue chains. The entire palace trembled, countless debris falling from the dome.

"Go quickly!" the old man low-pitched shout, his form already beginning to dissipate. "The seal left by the Tianji Pavilion Master is about to be exhausted. Take the girl's bloodline power and leave this place!"

Chen Ji gave the old man one deep look, said nothing more, grabbed Su Qingyao and charged toward the palace exterior. Behind them came violent rumbling, the confrontation between seal and vertical pupil growing ever more intense.

"Chen Ji, that Elder..." Su Qingyao looked back, her face full of worry.

"He is the remnant will of the Tianji Pavilion Master, staying here to suppress the Heavenly Eye." Chen Ji said heavily, yet his steps grew more resolute. "He could make this choice, which means he had waited far too long. We cannot disappoint his sacrifice."

Passing through the corridor, leaping over debris, the two finally burst out of the palace. Behind them came a muffled boom, and that palace bearing ten thousand years of sealing collapsed, stirring up漫天尘埃.

Chen Ji stopped, looking back. Within the dust, that vertical pupil remained faintly visible, but had been re-suppressed within the seal. And the old man's figure had long since vanished without a trace.

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao stared blankly at that pile of ruins, then suddenly asked quietly: "Chen Ji, you... exactly who are you?"

Chen Ji turned to look at her, his gaze flickering with complex emotions. After a moment, he suddenly smiled: "Does it matter who I am?" He brushed the dust from her hair, his gesture so gentle as if he wasn't dealing with an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow. "What matters is, you're unharmed."

text.content:
Su Qingyao was rendered speechless by his words. She opened her mouth, wanting to say something, but in the end could only sigh lightly: "You truly are... unfathomable."

Chen Ji offered no response, merely gazing toward the horizon deep within the Forbidden Grounds. Although that vertical pupil had been resealed just now, the Heavenly Eye had not truly awakened. Today's encounter was merely it testing the waters.

"Heavenly Fate Value remains at twenty-three." he calculated silently in his heart. "This trip to the Forbidden Grounds yielded far more than expected. Su Qingyao's Heavenly Realm bloodline, my father's truth, the Heavenly Eye's threat... The fog on the chessboard is gradually lifting."

He clenched his fist, his eyes flashing with determination: "Fine. Since you all want to treat me as a chess piece, I'll flip this chessboard over and become the chess player myself!"

In the distance, the exit of the Forbidden Grounds was dimly visible. And beyond that light, an ancient yet authoritative voice seemed to be calling—an omen of some远古存在 awakening.
